entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Lari Mosque is a mosque in the provincial center of Edirne, Turkey built in the early 16th century by Hakim Abdülhamid Lari Çelebi, who served as the head physician in the palace during the reigns of Fatih Sultan Mehmet and Bayezid II. The mosque is popularly known as Lâleli Mosque.
